period_note: Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported). Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January of the same year (as published in UCB's own annual report's 'Evaluation of Quarterly Financial Statements by the Audit Committee and by the Board' table -- a BSEC-mandated corporate-governance disclosure, not a discrete-quarter figure) -- flagged via the _cumulative suffix, same convention as CITYBANK. Re-sourced via fresh PDF download and dual independent re-extraction (see source.source_document); unlike the FY2015 report, all eight of this table's column headers are correctly and unambiguously labeled. eps_cumulative (0.42) and nav_per_share (22.78) both reproduce exactly from this quarter's own figures divided by 1,054.131m shares outstanding (paid-up capital 10,541.31m / BDT10 par, a further 5% stock dividend on top of 2015's). SEPARATE FINDING (does not affect this file's own values): this same table's comparative column for FY2015 shows NAV/share of 30.59 and EPS of 3.77, both of which disagree with FY2015's own contemporaneous annual report (25.49 and 3.96, already recorded in 2015_Q4.json and kept unchanged here per project convention). The EPS figure (3.77) is explained by a standard BAS-33 retrospective restatement for the 2016 stock dividend (3.96/1.05 = 3.77 exactly), but the NAV figure (30.59) is not explained the same way -- dividing FY2015's own unchanged equity (25,588.82) by 30.59 implies a share count of ~836.5m, i.e. the OLD (FY2014-vintage, pre-2015-bonus) share count, not FY2015's actual year-end count of 1,003.934m. This looks like a genuine computation error in UCB's FY2016 report for this one comparative cell (NAV/share is a point-in-time ratio that BAS-33 does not require restating for a later bonus issue, unlike EPS), recorded here as a discrepancy rather than silently reconciled -- see sources.json.

source.source_document: Annual-report-2016.pdf, PDF page 103 (printed page 101) -- re-downloaded directly from ucb.com.bd for this extraction for the same reason as the 2015 file (the archived ucb-annual-report-2016.txt's pdftotext rendering of this table has the same missing-separator corruption; this PDF is likewise a pure 146dpi image scan with no embedded text layer). Re-rendered at 400dpi and read directly, then cross-checked with a full-page tesseract 5.5.3 OCR pass; the two methods agreed on every one of the table's 68 data cells. The PDF was deleted immediately after extraction per project policy.
